# Waveform presets

A **waveform preset** is one of the program's twenty-eight built-in color presets: Cool Edit Pro 2.1's own twenty and the program's own eight. It colors the waveform and its canvas, the grid and center lines, the markers, the playhead and the scanner, and the keys' lit lamps take the hue of its waveform color; the rest of the window is the program's black hi-fi panel, which no preset changes.

To choose one, press the toolbar's Settings button and type `waveform=` and a key from the lists below (Tab completes a typed beginning, and a Tab right after `waveform=` adds the key in use), then press OK or Enter: it applies at once and is kept for the next launch. Cancel or Esc leaves the colors as they were. A word that is no preset's key is refused.

The default: Default (`cool-edit-default`).

## Presets

Cool Edit Pro 2.1's twenty color presets, in Cool Edit's own order, as their text stands inside its program file (coolpro.exe). Two of them carry no name there; 3D and Easy on the Eyes are their names in Cool Edit's own registry entries.

- Each preset's Panel Face, Cool Edit's color for its panels, is not used: the program's panel is its black hi-fi ground, and no preset's Panel Face is read.
- The waveform's outline is not one of Cool Edit's colors: each preset's is its waveform color darkened, the same hue at a fixed lightness.
- The Invalid color, which marks an invalid marker, is each preset's own center-line color.
- The scanner (the line that moves during playback) and the zoom's anchor line are white in every preset, as Cool Edit's scanner is on every one of its presets.

| Preset | Key |
|---|---|
| Default (the default) | `cool-edit-default` |
| XP Blue | `cool-edit-xp-blue` |
| XP Silver | `cool-edit-xp-silver` |
| XP Olive | `cool-edit-xp-olive` |

| Classic Cool | `cool-edit-classic-cool` |
| Lipstick and Grapes | `cool-edit-lipstick-and-grapes` |
| Seattle Blues | `cool-edit-seattle-blues` |
| Midnight | `cool-edit-midnight` |
| Periwinkle | `cool-edit-periwinkle` |
| CEPro 1.2 | `cool-edit-cepro-1-2` |
| 3D | `cool-edit-3d` |
| Stealth | `cool-edit-stealth` |
| Grape, Lime, and Tangerine | `cool-edit-grape-lime-and-tangerine` |
| Dusty Rose | `cool-edit-dusty-rose` |

## The program's own presets

Eight presets of the program's own, made for its black panel: a softer waveform color than Cool Edit's and two marker colors easy to tell apart, the outline, the Invalid color (a red, their center line's) and the scanner following the same rules as Cool Edit's above.

| Preset | Key |
|---|---|
| Phosphor, Gold and Ice | `warptempo-phosphor-gold-and-ice` |
| Phosphor, Cyan and Sky | `warptempo-phosphor-cyan-and-sky` |
| Mint, Gold and Frost | `warptempo-mint-gold-and-frost` |
| Sea Glass, Gold and Leaf | `warptempo-sea-glass-gold-and-leaf` |
| Icy, Gold and Leaf | `warptempo-icy-gold-and-leaf` |
| Soft Midnight, Mauve and Sky | `warptempo-soft-midnight-mauve-and-sky` |
| Amber, Ice and Leaf | `warptempo-amber-ice-and-leaf` |
| Phosphor, Mauve and Sky | `warptempo-phosphor-mauve-and-sky` |
